meta.title: Cybersecurity & DevOps Summit 2026 | TenthMatrix
meta.description: Join the annual Cybersecurity & DevOps Summit bringing together security and DevOps professionals to explore zero trust, DevSecOps, SIEM, Kubernetes security, and supply chain security.
meta.keywords: cybersecurity summit, devops conference, devsecops, zero trust, kubernetes security, supply chain security, SIEM, london tech events 2026

hero.title: Cybersecurity & DevOps Summit
hero.description: Bringing together security and DevOps professionals to tackle the most pressing challenges in modern infrastructure protection. Join us for two days of expert talks, hands-on workshops, and networking.

topics.title: Zero Trust Architecture
topics.description: Implementing zero trust principles across cloud-native infrastructure, identity-aware proxies, and micro-segmentation strategies.

topics.title: DevSecOps Pipelines
topics.description: Embedding security scanning, vulnerability assessment, and compliance checks directly into CI/CD workflows.

topics.title: SIEM & Threat Detection
topics.description: Modern SIEM platforms, real-time threat intelligence, anomaly detection with AI, and automated incident response.

topics.title: Kubernetes Security
topics.description: Securing container orchestration with pod security policies, network policies, runtime protection, and image signing.

topics.title: Supply Chain Security
topics.description: SBOM generation, dependency vulnerability scanning, signed builds, and securing the software delivery lifecycle.

topics.title: Cloud Security Posture
topics.description: Multi-cloud security management, infrastructure-as-code security scanning, and compliance automation across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

highlights: Networking with 500+ security and DevOps professionals
Access to recorded sessions for 6 months
Exhibition area showcasing latest security tools
